def solve():
    grid_str = """+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
+ + + + - - - - - - X - - - - - - - +
+ $ + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + - - @ - - - - - - - - - X - - +

+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - @ - - +
+ - - - X @ - - - + - - - - - * @ X +
+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - @ - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - X @ - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - @ - - - +
+ - - + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + + - - - - - - - - - + X + - +
+ + + + + - - - - - - - - - - + + + +
+ + + + - - - + + - - - - - - + + + +
+ + + $ + - - + + + + + + + + + + + +
+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
+ + + + + + + + + + + $ + + + + + + +
+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +"""
    grid = [line.split() for line in grid_str.strip().split('\n')]
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    goals = set()
    boxes = set()
    player_pos = None
    walls = set()
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            char = grid[r][c]
            if char == '+': walls.add((r, c))
            elif char == 'X': goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '@': boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == '$': goals.add((r, c)); boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == '*': player_pos = (r, c)
            elif char == '%': player_pos = (r, c); goals.add((r, c))

    def get_h(boxes):
        h = 0
        for b in boxes:
            h += min(abs(b[0]-g[0]) + abs(b[1]-g[1]) for g in goals)
        return h

    start_boxes = frozenset(boxes)
    pq = [(get_h(start_boxes), 0, player_pos, start_boxes, "")]
    visited = {(player_pos, start_boxes): 0}

    while pq:
        h, g, p, bxs, path = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if bxs == goals:
            return path
        
        r, c = p
        for dr, dc, move in [(-1,0,'U'), (1,0,'D'), (0,-1,'L'), (0,1,'R')]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if (nr, nc) in walls: continue
            if (nr, nc) in bxs:
                nnr, nnc = nr+dr, nc+dc
                if (nnr, nnc) in walls or (nnr, nnc) in bxs: continue
                new_bxs = set(bxs)
                new_bxs.remove((nr, nc))
                new_bxs.add((nnr, nnc))
                new_bxs = frozenset(new_bxs)
                if ( (nr, nc), new_bxs ) not in visited or visited[((nr, nc), new_bxs)] > g + 1:
                    visited[((nr, nc), new_bxs)] = g + 1
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (g + 1 + get_h(new_bxs), g + 1, (nr, nc), new_bxs, path + move))
            else:
                if ( (nr, nc), bxs ) not in visited or visited[((nr, nc), bxs)] > g + 1:
                    visited[((nr, nc), bxs)] = g + 1
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (g + 1 + get_h(bxs), g + 1, (nr, nc), bxs, path + move))
    return "No solution"

print(solve())"}

            elif char == '$': goals.add((r, c)); boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == '*': player_pos = (r, c)
            elif char == '%': player_pos = (r, c); goals.add((r, c))

    def is_deadlock(bxs):
        for b in bxs:
            if b in goals: continue
            r, c = b
            # Corner deadlock
            up = (r-1, c) in walls
            down = (r+1, c) in walls
            left = (r, c-1) in walls
            right = (r, c+1) in walls
            if (up or down) and (left or right): return True
        return False

    start_boxes = frozenset(boxes)
    queue = collections.deque([(player_pos, start_boxes, "")])
    visited = {(player_pos, start_boxes)}

    while queue:
        p, bxs, path = queue.popleft()
        if bxs == goals: return path

        for dr, dc, move in [(-1,0,'U'), (1,0,'D'), (0,-1,'L'), (0,1,'R')]:

                new_bxs.add((nnr, nnc))

                if ((nr, nc), new_bxs) not in visited:
                    visited.add(((nr, nc), new_bxs))
                    queue.append(((nr, nc), new_bxs, path + move))

                    visited.add(((nr, nc), bxs))
                    queue.append(((nr, nc), bxs, path + move))
    return "No solution"

print(solve())"}
